「Fold successful!
　We've crossed the wall of dimensions!」

$$モニカ$$
「Most of the surface seems to be covered in artificial structures」

stage0089b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「It's like a sea of iron...」

stage0089b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ラム$$
「All units are being recovered.
　We can launch again immediately.」

stage0089b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Can you hear me, Altair's Commander $$イズモ・カムロギ$$.
　This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$ of $c」

stage0089b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We haven't come here to fight.
　Return the women taken from our Earth,
　and give back the Mythical Aquarion for both worlds' peace」

stage0089b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Still no word on the true Mechanical Angel's whereabouts.
　But if Vega gets hold of it first,
　it will be used to attack us...）

stage0089b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Altair has begun its attack!」

stage0089b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No choice, then...
　Launch all units.」

stage0089b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$シュレード$$, can you still fight!?」

stage0089b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Save your concern, $$アマタ$$.
　Having grasped a fragment of the ultimate
　melody, I can't afford to stop now.」

stage0089b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...Got it.
　I won't say anything more.」

stage0089b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Big talk for coward $$アマタ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　Where's the true Mechanical Angel, the Wings of the sun!?
　That kept Altair and Vega in balance!」

stage0089b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Like hell I know!
　Ask that bastard $$ミカゲ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$イズモ$$
「You...!
　You don't care what becomes of Altair!」

stage0089b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That damn woman $$シルフィ$$ matters more to me!」

stage0089b_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Oh, you're mad now!
　But I'm still taking $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Stay out of this, $$ミコノ$$!
　If we don't beat him and $$ミカゲ$$, the Mythical
　Aquarion won't come back!」

stage0089b_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アルト$$
「Watch out, $$アマタ$$!
　Both $$ＭＩＸ$$ and $$カグラ$$ are coming after you!」

stage0089b_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Bring it on!
　I'll settle things with him and save $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$イズモ$$
「All units, intercept the warriors of Vega!
　Leave $$カグラ$$ be, it doesn't matter!」

stage0089b_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Wait for me, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　I'll definitely save you!」

stage0089b_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Watch out, $$アマタ$$!
　$$カグラ$$'s come back!」

stage0089b_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アマタ$$
「He's still got more fight in him!」

stage0089b_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't think something like this will stop me!」

stage0089b_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　You're still fighting!」

stage0089b_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Here I come, $$アマタ$$!
　The real fight starts now!!」

stage0089b_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　You who cares nothing for Altair, I will purge you!
　With the power of this planet!」

stage0089b_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$カレン$$
「Him...!
　He got out right before the explosion!」

stage0089b_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$葵$$
「Tough as a wild animal, huh.
　Even I have to tip my hat to that.」

stage0089b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What is that, the firepower on that white machine...!」

stage0089b_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$キラ$$
「That wasn't there in the last battle...!」

stage0089b_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This is the Homeworld Total War Cannon... the Altair Cannon...!
　Altair's ultimate weapon, firing out the energy
　gathered by Iron-C!」

stage0089b_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$オズマ$$
「So Altair's strongest weapon joins
　Altair's strongest machine and pilot!」

stage0089b_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「This really is the decisive battle...!
　Neither side can afford to lose!」

stage0089b_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「All we want is to get back the women who were
　taken, and the Mythical Aquarion...!」

stage0089b_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I'll teach you this, boy.
　A person must answer for what they've done...」

stage0089b_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I led this Altair into war against
　your world, Vega,
　paying many sacrifices along the way.」

stage0089b_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$イズモ$$
「That's why I cannot lose!
　Not while $$アリシア$$'s sacrifice still matters!」

stage0089b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$イズモ$$...
　I salute your resolve.」

stage0089b_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$エマ$$
「That many, in a situation like this...!」

stage0089b_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh heh... this isn't the end.」

stage0089b_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'll gift you twenty $$ケルビム兵$$
　every minute.」

stage0089b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$リディ$$
「Are you saying it's an endless army!?」

stage0089b_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Judging by our relative strength, if the enemy
　tops 100 units, we won't stand a chance!」

stage0089b_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, you heard that!
　The enemy sends in 20 reinforcements a minute!」

stage0089b_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We settle this before their numbers
　pass 100!」

stage0089b_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Our target is their commander, $$イズモ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Come, warriors of Vega!
　I'll defeat you and bring Altair a future!!」

stage0089b_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We're fighting too...!
　We're fighting to bring about a future too!」

stage0089b_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We're fighting for the world just the same!
　There's no way we can lose!!」

stage0089b_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Something like this won't bring me down!」

stage0089b_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Guess he's not using that planet's power for show!」

stage0089b_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$スザク$$
「So strong...!
　Is this what unshakeable resolve looks like!」

stage0089b_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「All I see in that man is someone pitiful, though.」

stage0089b_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$シュレード$$
「And this planet's power, too, is running out...
　Same as me...」

stage0089b_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Eve's curse isn't the only misfortune that struck this planet...」

stage0089b_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Iron-C, which draws up the energy of the earth
　that my mother, Oriza, built...」

stage0089b_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This system, meant to bring Altair eternal
　prosperity, began mysteriously breaking down
　within a few mere decades.」

stage0089b_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Losing the women, and now losing energy too...
　That would mean...」

stage0089b_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「That's right.
　This planet has no future left...」

stage0089b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$イズモ$$
「That's why I borrowed $$ミカゲ$$'s power,
　and sought a future in Vega!」

stage0089b_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$シン$$
「And for that, you chose to resort to war!」

stage0089b_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「As a leader, you chose the wrong means.」

stage0089b_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「When two races meet, conflict is born from it.
　All I can do is keep that to a minimum.」

stage0089b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, it's not zero!」

stage0089b_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't go deciding on your own that two races meeting means conflict!」

stage0089b_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$刹那$$
「What you lacked
　was the heart to try to understand others!」

stage0089b_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$桂$$
「No point telling him.
　...He's the king of a world with no girls left.
　Bet he's never even been in love.」

stage0089b_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$桂$$
「Asking a guy like that to understand
　anyone else was never gonna happen.」

stage0089b_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Not going to argue, $$イズモ・カムロギ$$?」

stage0089b_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$シュレード$$
「The love and sorrow inside you, your sense
　of duty and regret, ring out as Lamentabile.」

stage0089b_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「So that is... what lies within my heart...」

stage0089b_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「At this rate, we'll be overwhelmed eventually...!」

stage0089b_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Unable to stop the world's end, and dying

$$イズモ$$
「Is this as far as you get, warriors of Vega!」

stage0089b_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:

「He's called up skeleton troops again!」

stage0089b_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$シュレード$$
「One who couldn't even die, huh...
　Seems he can see my fate.」

stage0089b_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Commanding the dead, hunting my fate...
　He's less a Wing than... a Reaper.」

stage0089b_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$シュレード$$
「And before that, scattering so fleetingly,
　I'm just like Kagerou...」

stage0089b_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$バサラ$$
「You giving up, $$シュレード$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Your sound's gonna lose to fate!」

stage0089b_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Don't die, $$シュレード$$!
　Your heartbeat is the ultimate melody!」

stage0089b_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$バサラ$$
「$$シュレード$$!
　Let my... let our souls ring out!!」

stage0089b_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「But $$バサラ$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$ aren't singing!」

stage0089b_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アルト$$
「I can hear $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s song...」

stage0089b_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アルト$$
「They're singing with everything they have!
　Trusting us!」

stage0089b_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$甲児$$
「It's not just those two!
　Everyone's fighting, believing in themselves!」

stage0089b_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$n
「That's not all we believe in!
　Our friends, our future...」

stage0089b_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$宗介$$
「And above all...!
　We believe in victory!」

stage0089b_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$シュレード$$
「My own future... victory...
　That is...」

stage0089b_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$クレア$$
「Go, $$シュレード$$!
　$$カイエン$$, back him up!」

stage0089b_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Play it, $$シュレード$$!
　Your sound... your soul!!」

stage0089b_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$シュレード$$
「What a long way around...
　The scales of two stars overlap,
　becoming pure white light...」

stage0089b_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That's the blank space in one's own heart...
　Or perhaps a new world...!
　Just like a pure white musical staff...!」

stage0089b_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シュレード$$
「This is the last melody I found...!
　The true music of Aquarion, born from nothing...!
　Yes, the song of the beginning!」

stage0089b_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$シュレード$$
「To live is to carve one's mark.
　I'll play life, carve it in,
　and open the path ahead with you...!」

stage0089b_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I never... would have dreamed of this...
　before. Playing life together with someone...」

stage0089b_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Now, a new myth is born!」

stage0089b_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I can feel it...!
　My friend's soul, so close!」

stage0089b_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Now, let's fight together, $$カイエン$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シュレード$$
「This is the ultimate melody I found...!
　The sound of life!!」

stage0089b_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This is... the power of life!」

stage0089b_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「We did it, $$シュレード$$!
　We broke his power of death!」

stage0089b_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... Only because you helped me.」

stage0089b_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Right now, I'm overflowing
　with life... with future!」

stage0089b_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$シュレード$$...!
　You've overcome fate!」

stage0089b_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Vanish, messengers of the world of death!」

stage0089b_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That guy!
　He drove off the Reaper with music!」

stage0089b_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You wingless wretch...!
　To think one like you would defy fate!」

stage0089b_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Remember this well!
　One day, I will punish you!」

stage0089b_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カヲル$$
「This outcome...
　Did you lend a hand?」

stage0089b_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$不動$$
「No...
　They overcame fate with their own hands.」

stage0089b_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Well, yeah.
　Since I get to hear his wonderful sound again.」

stage0089b_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$カヲル$$
「And it makes me happy, too.
　That fate can be changed by human hands.」

stage0089b_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Amazing, $$シュレード$$!
　To think you got the better of $$ミカゲ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$カイエン$$
「It's not just him you beat!
　You overcame fate itself!」

stage0089b_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Overcoming fate...
　Has a nice ring to it.」

stage0089b_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$桂$$
「We can't lose to $$シュレード$$ either!」

stage0089b_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yeah!
　This fight... I'll win it, no matter what!」

stage0089b_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$イズモ$$
「So your fighting spirit, once nearly
　broken, has revived!」

stage0089b_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$アムロ$$
「All that's left is to defeat that man...!」

stage0089b_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Asking about Mom will have to wait...!
　First, beat him and reclaim
　the Mythical Aquarion!」

stage0089b_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And I'll protect it!
　Our world!!」

stage0089b_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Impossible...
　Am I... going to lose...」

stage0089b_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$イズモ$$
「No... the moment I turned to ways
　outside the path of man, this end
　was already decided...」

stage0089b_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$キャシー$$
「It looks like the enemy commander's
　ejected from their unit!」

stage0089b_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ケルビム兵$$!
　$$ミカゲ$$, still not giving up!」

stage0089b_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Neither we nor the Altair army know any restraint!」

stage0089b_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Is that bastard seriously gonna spread
　hatred at everything but himself!」

stage0089b_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「At this rate it'll turn into a free-for-all!」

stage0089b_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アマタ$$!
　You lot head down and go after
　the enemy commander!」

stage0089b_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$, $n, $$宗介$$!
　You three search for $$ランカ$$
　and $$シェリル$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$アルト$$
「Hang on, $$シェリル$$! $$ランカ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ラム$$
「$$アマタ$$ has boarded Aquarion!
　$$ゼシカ$$ and $$ミコノ$$'s whereabouts are unknown,
　but $$ＭＩＸ$$ is continuing the search!」

stage0089b_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Confirmed a powerful gravity wave
　outside Altair's atmosphere!
　The dimensional boundary is warping!」

stage0089b_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Is this... another Earth...?
　No, guess not...」

stage0089b_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$タケル$$
「An abnormal gravity wave, of all things!」

stage0089b_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Just as you imagine.
　My father has come to Earth.」

stage0089b_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$シモン$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ has come, has he!」

stage0089b_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$竜馬$$
「His power's reaching us across dimensions!」

stage0089b_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$隼人$$
「Are you saying the physical distance
　between Altair and Earth is shrinking!?」

stage0089b_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「That's right.
　My father's power will soon destroy
　both Earths.」

stage0089b_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$グーラ$$
「But first, I will bury just you with my own power...!
　On my pride as the Demon Beast Prince!」

stage0089b_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$... I have nothing more to say to you.」

stage0089b_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$c...!
　I invite you all to the decisive battlefield!」

stage0089b_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm going!
　I'm the one who'll fill the hole
　in $$ＭＩＸ$$'s heart!」

stage0089b_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$クレア$$
「Element Change!
　Go, $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「Tch! Come to finish me off, huh!」

stage0089b_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What are you talking about, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　I just want to get you back!」

stage0089b_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Remember, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Remember me...! This $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Remember, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　I'm $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$カイエン$$
「At this rate we're just going in circles!」

stage0089b_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'll do it as many times as it takes!
　Until I hold $$ＭＩＸ$$ in these arms!」

stage0089b_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I open a hole, and $$ＭＩＸ$$ fills it!
　That's how we've understood each other!」

stage0089b_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「Why... why does repeating this
　pointless act feel so nostalgic...!」

stage0089b_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$アンディ$$, there's no getting through!」

stage0089b_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Any more of this is dangerous!」

stage0089b_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「If I quit now, what'll happen to $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$カレン$$
「The trash pickup we all did together!」

stage0089b_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$さやか$$
「And after that, all the love talk
　we got excited about at the donut shop!」

stage0089b_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「Why...?
　Why go so far, for me...?」

stage0089b_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm never giving up, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Not until I hold you in these arms!」

stage0089b_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I want to fill the hole in you!!」

stage0089b_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「I-I hate holes!
　I hate you so much!!」

stage0089b_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I will never give up!
　$$ＭＩＸ$$! Not until I fill the hole
　gaping in your heart, with me!」

stage0089b_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Finally, I could hold you!
　My $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「...The gaps in my lost memories
　are being filled in...! My memories
　as a woman, that I'd lost...」

stage0089b_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「And the one who was always there... $$アンディ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「You, did your memory come back!?」

stage0089b_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I don't care about that...」

stage0089b_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$アンディ$$
「It doesn't matter if you're a man
　or a woman. I like the person
　called $$ＭＩＸ$$」

stage0089b_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Let's go home!
　Back to our friends!」

stage0089b_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$アマタ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Chairwoman $$クレア$$!
　Please, take care of $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$クレア$$
「Understood!
　All of you, return to the front!」

stage0089b_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$n
「That's a victory won by your guts!」

stage0089b_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't go spouting lines that don't suit you!」

stage0089b_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's one goal accomplished!
　Let's go, $$アマタ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn it!
　Let's fall back and regroup!!」

stage0089b_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Wait!
　I need to talk to you...」

stage0089b_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Stop it, $$ミコノ$$!
　He's our enemy!」

stage0089b_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（But... I have to apologize...
　to him...）

stage0089b_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$赤木$$
「What's going on with that thing!?」

stage0089b_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's the same as $$イズモ$$'s $$アフラ・グニス$$.
　I've been allowed to use Altair's power too」

stage0089b_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「You wretch!
　Using Iron-C for your own selfish gain!」

stage0089b_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Isn't it fine, $$イズモ$$?
　In exchange, I'm providing you with military strength」

stage0089b_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Damn it...!
　I must fight Vega's warriors first, is that it!」

stage0089b_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, ignore $$ミカゲ$$ for now!
　Focus your attacks on the enemy Supreme Commander!」

stage0089b_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're saying we just let him roam free!?」

stage0089b_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I said 'for now'!
　He will answer for this, without fail!」

stage0089b_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... if you wingless can manage it, that is」

stage0089b_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hold on a sec!
　If the enemy keeps growing like this, we can't win!」

stage0089b_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We have to do something about it before then!」

stage0089b_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Fufufu... struggle all you like, wingless.
　Though this won't ease my hatred one bit」

stage0089b_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$キャシー$$
「With this much of a gap, we can't even withdraw!」

stage0089b_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Did I misjudge when to pull back...」

stage0089b_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Hahahaha, you wingless lot!
　Let's begin a cruel show, shall we!
　Hahahaha, hahahahahaha!」

stage0089b_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Even if the world you grew up in
　is about to be destroyed, you
　feel nothing at all!?」

stage0089b_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Like I give a damn about that!
　The planet's future means nothing
　to me! All I need is that damn woman!」

stage0089b_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Even if I make the whole world
　my enemy, all I need is that
　damn woman!」

stage0089b_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Shut up, $$カグラ$$!
　I won't accept you!!」

stage0089b_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll protect $$ミコノ$$
　and the world she loves!!」

stage0089b_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Stop this, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Listen to our... to $$アンディ$$'s voice!」

stage0089b_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「What do I care about you people!
　I'm $$ＭＩＸＹ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「You are enemies of me and Altair!
　You who've trespassed into this Iron-C
　I will eliminate!」

stage0089b_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Damn it!
　All we can do now is take away
　the power to fight!」

stage0089b_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Whoever you are, whatever
　your reasons, I won't forgive
　you for attacking our world!」

stage0089b_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Winged boy, I have no intention of begging forgiveness」

stage0089b_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Yes... if there's something I'd
　beg your forgiveness for,
　it's something else entirely」

stage0089b_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But for now, let us fight!
　Casting aside all else, for my
　home planet, Altair!」

stage0089b_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Like hell I'll lose!
　We came here with our own resolve too!!」

stage0089b_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Our opponent is the strongest
　machine and pilot of an entire
　planet! We can't let our guard down!」

stage0089b_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I take you for one of Vega's
　strongest warriors! A worthy
　opponent indeed!」

stage0089b_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You're just like a man I know!
　Carrying everything alone, thinking
　only you can save the world!」

stage0089b_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's nothing but ego!
　You're just one person living
　in this world, same as anyone else!」

stage0089b_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$イズモ$$
「How naive.
　Even with good talent, you lack
　the experience to put it to use」

stage0089b_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that what being an adult means,
　talking as if you understand
　it all!」

stage0089b_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Never even trying the possibilities,
　just swinging your own logic
　around to pick a fight, is that being an adult!?」

stage0089b_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Taking responsibility for one's
　own acts is a full-grown man's duty!
　That's why I must win!」

stage0089b_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's nothing but an excuse!!」

stage0089b_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「My opponent's Altair's strongest
　man! Now this gets my blood pumping!」

stage0089b_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Is this man enjoying the fight!」

stage0089b_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't get the wrong idea!
　I've got the resolve to fight
　for the world too!」

stage0089b_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's why I'm blasting a villain
　like you, and protecting the world!」

stage0089b_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you're the supreme commander,
　act with the people of Altair
　in mind!」

stage0089b_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「My fight is for the sake of
　my people! Not a shred of
　self-interest in it!」

stage0089b_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$赤木$$
「Can people live happily in a city
　smothered by rigid machines
　like this!」

stage0089b_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you're a leader, think about people's
　lives before you think about fighting!」

stage0089b_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$赤木$$
「On behalf of this city's people,
　I'll open your eyes myself!」

stage0089b_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I see. You may indeed be a powerful
　leader, but turn that over and it's
　nothing more than a dictatorship.」

stage0089b_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$イズモ$$
「What Altair needs right now is power!
　Even if you call me evil for it,
　I will fight for my homeworld!」

stage0089b_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Knowing your own acts are evil, yet
　calling it unavoidable. The stock
　line of an incompetent dictator.」

stage0089b_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll show you the end that awaits
　a rule built on nothing but power!」

stage0089b_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's defeat to an even greater power!」

stage0089b_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$シモン$$
「I've stood above others myself once!
　I get some of what you're going through!」

stage0089b_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Then stand aside and let me pass!
　I must save Altair!」

stage0089b_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$シモン$$
「Try to kick reason aside with brute
　force all you want, it won't work!
　Then I'm not budging an inch either!」

stage0089b_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$シモン$$
「If we've both got something we won't
　give up, all that's left is to clash!
　But we are never gonna lose!!」

stage0089b_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$宗介$$
「This man's second-rate as a leader,
　but first-rate as a commander and
　soldier...!」

stage0089b_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Have you felt the power of me and
　$$アフラ・グニス$$ firsthand?」

stage0089b_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$宗介$$
「But in the end, most military
　regimes fall to a democratic
　liberation front.」

stage0089b_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$宗介$$
「You'll learn that a man who knows
　nothing but ruling through force
　can't build a nation's future!」

stage0089b_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$アルト$$
「Whatever the reason, I won't forgive
　you for taking $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$!」

stage0089b_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This boy too puts his feelings on wings!」

stage0089b_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Get out of my way! I'll save $$シェリル$$
　and $$ランカ$$, and protect the world!」

stage0089b_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Protecting one you love, and the world...
　To me, who sacrificed my love to save
　the world, your strength dazzles me...）

stage0089b_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$n
「Let me tell you, dictator.
　No matter how much you reason it away,
　I won't accept you for starting this fight.」

stage0089b_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I'm not fighting because I want
　someone to accept me!」

stage0089b_04:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$n
「You're pathetic, you know that!
　Protecting the world means protecting
　the people who live in it!」

stage0089b_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$n
「Isn't there anyone you want to protect!?
　Anyone you want to walk into the future
　with!? What's the point in a world like that!?」

stage0089b_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Even so, I have to see this through!
　For $$アリシア$$ too, who gave up their
　life for my sake, that day!」

stage0089b_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$シュレード$$
（My life will soon come to an end...）

stage0089b_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$シュレード$$
（But before that, I'll find it, just watch...!
　My own ultimate melody!）

stage0089b_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$シュレード$$
（Somewhere, I'd given up on my own life...
　But that's changed now...!）

stage0089b_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$シュレード$$
（The power of life filling me...!
　The joy of beating my fear of death gives me strength!）

stage0089b_04:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$シュレード$$
（This heartbeat of life is my ultimate melody!
　I'll create a future I walk with friends and comrades!）

stage0089b_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Why...? Watching that creature,
　my heart grows more at ease...）

stage0089b_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Those days now gone by...
　I recall the days spent with $$アリシア$$
　at Vega...）

stage0089b_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$ボン太くん#pilot$$
「Fumofumo, fumomo! Fumo, fumo, fumoffu!」

stage0089b_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$イズモ$$
（...How sentimental of me. But even for
　a moment, thank you for reminding me
　of those peaceful days!）
